board.title: OPD board
board.description: Live queues for every doctor today. The board refreshes on its own.
board.searchPlaceholder: Name, phone, token or booking ID
board.noQueuesBody: No doctor has patients booked or waiting today.
board.noMatchesBody: Try another department or status, or check the spelling of the name, phone number or token.
board.noAppointmentsBody: Change the filters or clear the search to see everyone booked for today.

noShow.title: Mark as no-show?
noShow.body: {{name}} (token {{token}}) will be taken off {{doctor}}'s queue for today. If they arrive later, they will need a new walk-in token.

move.title: Move to another doctor
move.hint: The patient gets the new doctor's next free time today. Moving to another department gives them a new token.
move.noDoctors: No other doctor is available today.

walkIn.title: Walk-in registration
walkIn.description: Find or register the patient, choose a department and issue a token.
walkIn.search: Search by name or mobile number
walkIn.searchHint: Type at least 2 letters or digits.
walkIn.noMatchBody: Check the spelling or the number, or register them as a new patient.
walkIn.consentVerbal: The patient agreed verbally at the desk to the hospital storing these details and using them for their care.
walkIn.consentNotifications: Send token and queue updates by SMS or WhatsApp
walkIn.consentNotificationsHint: Optional. Tick only if the patient agreed.
walkIn.reasonHint: In the patient's own words, for example "knee pain for a week".
walkIn.selectPatientFirst: Find or register the patient first.
walkIn.noSlotsDoctor: This doctor has no free slots left today. Choose "Earliest available doctor" or another doctor.
walkIn.noSlotsDepartment: No doctor in this department has a free slot left today. Offer the patient a booking for another day.
walkIn.busyTitle: The patient already has a visit
walkIn.successBody: {{name}} is checked in and in the queue.

slip.title: OPD token
slip.note: Please wait near {{location}}. Your token number will be called.

escalations.title: Escalations
escalations.description: Patients the assistant could not route, or who asked to talk to a person. Call them back and note what you did.
escalations.openOrder: Oldest first, so nobody waits too long.
escalations.emptyOpenBody: When the assistant needs help from the desk, it will show up here.
escalations.emptyResolvedBody: Escalations you resolve will be listed here.
escalations.resolveBody: Write what you did, so colleagues can see it later.
escalations.resolutionHint: For example: called back and booked with General Medicine at 11:30.

quick.calledBack: Called the patient back and answered their question.
quick.booked: Called the patient back and booked an appointment.
quick.walkIn: Registered the patient as a walk-in at the desk.
